title: Procedural backrooms horror game
author: Prasenjit
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
I built a backrooms horror game with claude fable 5, before it got banned.

the entire thing runs in your browser, no image files, no audio files, everything is generated by code.

→ the monster is procedurally modeled. no 3D assets, just math
→ it hunts by sight AND sound sprinting gives you away
→ stare at it and it freezes. keep staring and it charges you
→ the maze is different every run. 48×48 grid, fully connected
→ all audio is synthesized in the browser footsteps, whispers, heartbeat
→ a fear shader kicks in as it gets closer film grain, vignette, chromatic aberration

built with next.js, react, three.js, typescript, zero external assets.
summary: Shows a browser-based backrooms horror game built with Fable 5 using Next.js, React, Three.js, TypeScript, procedural modeling, synthesized audio, and no external assets.
